Read identity.py, settings.py, main.py, payments.py, the Dockerfile, deployment.yaml, the CI workflow and the README. The agent makes credentialed API calls, so the requirement applies.
note: STS token exchange gives short-lived audience-bound tokens, but the Anthropic credential source, STS lifetimes and holder-binding support are not shown in the repo.
